convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom indicator 'ColorSchaffWPRTrendCycle', and depends on external .mqh library (TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for all trading operations including position open/close and money management.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe period in seconds for signal time calculation
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for position open calls

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before trading

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: uptrend signal closes sell, downtrend signal closes buy, controlled by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input flags

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing method: LOT=fixed lots (MM=0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic reads ColorSchaffWPRTrendCycle color buffer (buffer index 1): values >5 indicate uptrend (buy signal when bar0 transitions below 6 from bar1 >5), values <2 indicate downtrend (sell signal when bar0 transitions above 1 from bar1 <2). Signal is evaluated on bar index SignalBar (default=1, previous bar) with confirmation from bar 0. Signals are computed once per new bar and held static until next bar. Opposite-direction close is triggered simultaneously with entry signal. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans independently gate each trade action.
python_conversion_notes: The custom indicator ColorSchaffWPRTrendCycle must be ported to Python first - it is a Schaff Trend Cycle variant based on WPR (Williams Percent Range) with fast/slow cycling. The color buffer encodes trend state as integer values (1-2=downtrend, 6+=uptrend). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose wrappers that handle margin calculation per MarginMode enum and order execution with deviation. The MarginMode LOT mode is trivial (fixed lot size), but FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE modes require real-time account equity queries. Signal logic reads only 2 values from indicator buffer 1 at bars SignalBar and SignalBar-1, making the core logic simple once the indicator is replicated.
